title: Topological structure features enhanced portfolios: integration of asset clustering and price prediction
title_zh: 拓扑结构特征增强的投资组合：资产聚类与价格预测的整合
title_primary: 拓扑结构特征增强的投资组合：资产聚类与价格预测的整合
title_secondary: Topological structure features enhanced portfolios: integration of asset clustering and price prediction
authors: Xuyi Lv, Gaoxiu Qiao, Xiaobin Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Topology data analysis (TDA) explores the topological structure features of data from the geometric topology perspective. This study constructs investment portfolios by integrating asset clustering based on topological structure features and price prediction. First, we employ the Principal Component Analysis to reduce the dimensionality of nine topological features, and utilize the K-Medoids algorithm to cluster multiple assets based on the extracted principal components. Then, portfolios based on historical prices and predicted prices are constructed, respectively, with the latter effectively integrates the advantages of TDA and the predictive information. Based on closing prices of Chinese stock market, the performance of five TDA-based strategies are analysed and compared with five industry classification strategies. The results show that portfolios incorporating topological features outperform those based on industry classification, and portfolios integrating predicted prices further outperform those based on historical data. Specifically, the strategy combining TDA with volatility, and the strategy combining TDA with both predicted prices and Sharpe ratio, are particularly outstanding. This study verifies the core value of topological features in investment decision-making, providing a practical approach for portfolio construction. KEYWORDS: Portfolio strategy topology data analysis price prediction asset clustering JEL CLASSIFICATION: G11 G17
abstract_zh: 拓扑数据分析（TDA）从几何拓扑视角探索数据的拓扑结构特征。本研究通过整合基于拓扑结构特征的资产聚类与价格预测来构建投资组合。首先，我们采用主成分分析对九个拓扑特征进行降维，并利用K-Medoids算法基于提取的主成分对多个资产进行聚类。随后，分别基于历史价格和预测价格构建投资组合，后者有效融合了TDA的优势与预测信息。基于中国股市收盘价，我们分析了五种TDA策略的表现，并与五种行业分类策略进行比较。结果表明，纳入拓扑特征的投资组合优于基于行业分类的投资组合，而整合预测价格的投资组合进一步优于基于历史数据的投资组合。具体而言，结合TDA与波动率的策略，以及结合TDA与预测价格及夏普比率的策略表现尤为突出。本研究验证了拓扑特征在投资决策中的核心价值，为投资组合构建提供了一种实用方法。关键词：投资组合策略；拓扑数据分析；价格预测；资产聚类 JEL分类：G11 G17

title: Managerial Coordination in Decentralized Markets
title_zh: 分散市场中的管理协调
title_primary: 分散市场中的管理协调
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Why do some buyers contract directly with producers, while others contract via an intermediary that coordinates assignments and monitors performance? We develop a repeated-game model in which intermediaries aggregate fluctuating demand, lengthening productive relationships and making cooperation easier to sustain. This benefit comes at the cost of double marginalization: an added layer of rents is needed to motivate the intermediary. The trade-off determines which buyers rely on an intermediary and which contract directly. In equilibrium, producers working through intermediaries earn lower, less variable pay but greater job security. Intermediaries expand trade, yet shift its gains from producers to buyers. Managerial coordination also promotes specialization. The framework sheds new light on professional service firms, global sourcing intermediaries, and digital matching platforms.
abstract_zh: 为何部分买方直接与生产者签约，而另一些买方则通过协调任务分配并监督履约的中介机构进行签约？我们构建了一个重复博弈模型，其中中介机构通过整合波动的需求，延长生产关系的存续期，使合作更易维持。这一优势的代价是双重边际化：需要额外层级的租金来激励中介机构。这种权衡决定了哪些买方依赖中介机构、哪些买方直接签约。在均衡状态下，通过中介机构工作的生产者收入更低、波动性更小，但工作保障更高。中介机构扩大了贸易规模，却将贸易收益从生产者转移至买方。管理协调还促进了专业化分工。该框架为专业服务公司、全球采购中介及数字匹配平台提供了新的理论视角。

title: Courts of Tomorrow: Evidence from a Nationwide Rollout of Generative AI
title_zh: 明日法庭：生成式人工智能全国推广的证据
title_primary: 明日法庭：生成式人工智能全国推广的证据
title_secondary: Courts of Tomorrow: Evidence from a Nationwide Rollout of Generative AI
authors: Elliott Ash, Sultan Mehmood, Christoph Goessmann
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We present the first large-scale field experiment evaluating the integration of generative AI into a national justice system. In partnership with Pakistan's judiciary, we built JudgeGPT, a custom generative AI assistant designed for Pakistan's trial courts, and randomized 1,559 judges serving across 118 courts into one of three arms: (i) access to the assistant with targeted training tailored to its use; (ii) access to AI with generic training on technology and law; and (iii) generic training without access to AI. Judges who received AI access together with targeted training on the use of the tool were more likely to adopt it, use it more intensively, and continue using it over time. Their attitudes toward AI also shift: they expect the tool and the targeted training to increase their productivity. Administrative records move in the same direction: districts with greater exposure to treated judges resolve more cases. At median-district exposure, introducing AI with targeted training corresponds to 1,848 additional cases resolved per year, a 6.3 percent increase over the mean. This increase does not appear to come at the expense of reduced quality, as measured by case appeals (which slightly decline) or text-based measures of judicial writing (which slightly improve). Chat-log-based usage patterns suggest that judges use AI mainly to clarify legal concepts and support drafting. Targeted training appears to shift use toward tasks where language models are likely to be more useful, such as text improvement, and away from more open-ended legal queries where responses are more costly to verify. Overall, the results suggest that generative AI can raise public-sector productivity, but that these gains may depend on targeted training that directs use toward tasks for which the tool is better suited.
abstract_zh: 我们开展了首个大规模实地实验，评估将生成式人工智能整合进国家司法系统的效果。通过与巴基斯坦司法机构合作，我们构建了专为巴基斯坦初审法院设计的定制化生成式AI助手JudgeGPT，并将分布在118个法院的1559名法官随机分为三组：（i）获得AI助手并接受针对其使用的定向培训；（ii）获得AI助手并接受技术与法律通用培训；（iii）仅接受通用培训但无AI访问权限。结果显示，获得AI访问权限并接受定向培训的法官更倾向于采用该工具，使用频率更高且持续性更强。他们对AI的态度也发生转变：预期该工具及定向培训能提升自身工作效率。行政记录数据印证了这一趋势：接触过受训法官的地区案件处理量显著增加。在地区中位暴露水平下，引入AI并配合定向培训相当于每年多处理1848起案件，较均值提升6.3%。这种增长并未以质量下降为代价——案件上诉率（略有下降）和基于文本的司法文书质量指标（略有改善）均未出现负面变化。基于聊天日志的使用模式显示，法官主要利用AI澄清法律概念和辅助文书起草。定向培训促使使用行为从开放式法律咨询（此类回复验证成本较高）转向语言模型更擅长的任务（如文本优化）。总体而言，研究结果表明生成式AI能提升公共部门生产力，但这种提升可能取决于能否通过定向培训引导用户将工具应用于更适配的任务场景。

title: Rethinking the Effects of Financial Liberalization
title_zh: 重新思考金融自由化的效应
title_primary: 重新思考金融自由化的效应
title_secondary: Rethinking the Effects of Financial Liberalization
authors: Jaume Ventura, Fernando Broner, Isabel Schnabel, Christian Seckinger, Eduardo Levy Yeyati 等
official: 官方在线 2010-12-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper, we present a simple model that can account for the observed effects of financial liberalization. The model emphasizes the role of imperfect enforcement of domestic debts and the interactions between domestic and international financial transactions. In the model, financial liberalization might lead to different outcomes: (i) domestic capital flight and ambiguous effects on net capital flows, investment, and growth; (ii) large capital inflows and higher investment and growth; or (iii) volatile capital flows and unstable domestic financial markets. The model shows how these outcomes depend on the level of development, the depth of domestic financial markets, and the quality of institutions
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个简约模型，用以解释金融自由化可观测到的效应。该模型着重强调了国内债务执行不完善的作用，以及国内与国际金融交易之间的相互作用。在模型中，金融自由化可能导致三种不同结果：（i）国内资本外逃，且对净资本流动、投资和增长产生不确定影响；（ii）大规模资本流入，伴随投资与增长提升；（iii）资本流动波动加剧，国内金融市场不稳定。模型揭示了这些结果如何取决于发展水平、国内金融市场深度以及制度质量。

title: Money Illusion and Coordination Failure
official: 官方在线 2004-03-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Economists long considered money illusion to be largely irrelevant. Here we show, however, that money illusion has powerful effects on equilibrium selection. If we represent pay-offs in nominal terms, choices converge to the Pareto inefficient equilibrium; however, if we lift the veil of money by representing pay-offs in real terms, the Pareto efficient equilibrium is selected. We also show that strategic uncertainty about the other players? behaviour is key for the equilibrium selection effects of money illusion: even though money illusion vanishes over time if subjects are given learning opportunities in the context of an individual optimization problem, powerful and persistent effects of money illusion are found when strategic uncertainty prevails.
abstract_zh: 经济学家长期以来认为货币幻觉基本无关紧要。然而，本文表明货币幻觉对均衡选择具有显著影响。若以名义值表示收益，选择会收敛至帕累托低效均衡；但若通过实际值表示收益来揭开货币面纱，则会选择帕累托高效均衡。我们还发现，关于其他参与者行为的策略不确定性是货币幻觉产生均衡选择效应的关键：即便在个体优化问题情境下给予受试者学习机会时货币幻觉会随时间消退，但当策略不确定性占主导时，货币幻觉仍会产生强大且持续的影响。

title: Multiple Lenders and Corporate Distress: Evidence on Debt Restructuring
title_zh: 多个贷款人与企业困境：债务重组的证据
title_primary: 多个贷款人与企业困境：债务重组的证据
title_secondary: Multiple Lenders and Corporate Distress: Evidence on Debt Restructuring
authors: Jan-Pieter Krahnen, Antje Brunner, Jian Li, Yiming Ma, Caterina Mendicino 等
official: 官方在线 2004-03-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this Paper we address this topic empirically, relying on a unique panel dataset that includes detailed credit-fie information on distressed lending relationships in Germany. In particular, it includes information on bank pools: a legal institution aimed at coordinating lender interests in borrower distress. We find that the existence of small bank pools increases the probability of workout success and that coordination costs are positively related to pool size. We identify major determinants of pool formation, in particular the distribution of lending shares among banks, the number of banks, and the severity of the distress shock to the borrower.
abstract_zh: 本文基于一份独特的德国困境贷款关系面板数据集，对该主题进行了实证研究。该数据集特别包含了银行池的信息，这是一种旨在协调贷款人在借款人困境中利益的合法机构。我们发现，小型银行池的存在提高了重组成功的概率，且协调成本与银行池规模正相关。我们识别了银行池形成的主要决定因素，特别是银行间贷款份额的分布、银行数量以及借款人遭受困境冲击的严重程度。

title: Capital Constraints: How Bank Regulation Shapes Firm Export Behaviour
title_zh: 资本约束：银行监管如何塑造企业出口行为
title_primary: 资本约束：银行监管如何塑造企业出口行为
title_secondary: Capital Constraints: How Bank Regulation Shapes Firm Export Behaviour
abstract: This study investigates the impact of bank capital regulation on firms' export behaviour within a two‐country theoretical framework that explicitly incorporates the banking sector. We show that more stringent capital requirements discourage firms from exporting and reduce export scale by increasing financing costs through tighter lending conditions. Using a comprehensive dataset of listed firms in China, we find that higher bank capital adequacy ratios are associated with lower export propensity and export volumes, with effects particularly pronounced for firms more reliant on bank credit. We further explore the moderating roles of financial market development and monetary policy. The results indicate that more developed financial markets amplify the adverse effects of bank capital regulation on firms' export performance, whereas tighter monetary policy mitigates these effects. By integrating banking regulation, financial conditions, and firm‐level trade outcomes, this study contributes to the literature on banking and international trade and offers policy‐relevant insights for regulators seeking to balance financial stability with firms' international competitiveness.
abstract_zh: 本研究在明确纳入银行部门的两国理论框架下，探讨了银行资本监管对企业出口行为的影响。研究表明，更严格的资本要求通过收紧贷款条件提高融资成本，从而抑制企业出口意愿并降低出口规模。基于中国上市公司综合数据集，我们发现银行资本充足率越高，企业出口倾向与出口量越低，且该效应在更依赖银行信贷的企业中尤为显著。我们进一步探究了金融市场发展与货币政策的调节作用：结果显示，更发达的金融市场会放大银行资本监管对企业出口绩效的负面效应，而紧缩性货币政策则能缓解该影响。通过整合银行监管、金融条件与企业层面贸易结果，本研究为银行业与国际贸易领域的文献做出贡献，并为寻求平衡金融稳定与企业国际竞争力的监管者提供政策启示。

title: AI and the Collapse of the www
title_zh: 人工智能与万维网的崩溃
title_primary: 人工智能与万维网的崩溃
title_secondary: AI and the Collapse of the www
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies market design for generative AI intermediation. AI answer systems can improve user experience while diverting visits that finance publisher content and generate source-level quality signals. I show that an AI platform that underinternalizes future content reproduction retains too little referral traffic and can make costly open-web information subcritical, even with truthful content, accurate answers, and rational users. The mechanism can be self-reinforcing: less source-level measurement weakens conventional search, inducing further AI reliance. Sustainable repair requires replacing displaced revenue and deleted measurement through visitor-replacement royalties, audited provenance, human-information audits, and keystone-topic compensation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究生成式人工智能中介的市场设计。人工智能问答系统在改善用户体验的同时，会分流原本用于资助发布者内容并产生源级质量信号的访问流量。研究表明，若人工智能平台未能充分内化未来内容再生产的影响，其保留的推荐流量将过少，甚至可能使开放网络信息陷入临界不足状态——即便在内容真实、答案准确且用户理性的条件下也是如此。该机制可能形成自我强化：源级测量减少会削弱传统搜索功能，进而促使人工智能进一步被依赖。可持续修复需要借助访客替代版税、审计溯源、人工信息审计及关键主题补偿等手段，来弥补被替代的收入与被删除的测量数据。

title: Unfiltered Consumption and the Elasticity of Intertemporal Substitution
title_zh: 无过滤消费与跨期替代弹性
title_primary: 无过滤消费与跨期替代弹性
title_secondary: Unfiltered Consumption and the Elasticity of Intertemporal Substitution
abstract: This paper estimates the elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS) from the aggregate consumption Euler equation using Kroencke’s (2017) unfiltered consumption data. Unlike the published NIPA series used in most studies, unfiltered consumption is designed to recover the latent series obscured by statistical smoothing. Using weak-instrument-robust GMM inference, we show that this measurement choice matters for EIS estimation. With conventional filtered consumption, confidence sets typically include zero and are often uninformative. With unfiltered consumption, confidence sets exclude zero and provide a positive lower bound. The near-zero EIS estimates in the literature may partly reflect a measurement artifact rather than household preferences.

title: Optimal redistribution with labor supply dependent productivity
title_zh: 劳动供给依赖型生产率下的最优再分配
title_primary: 劳动供给依赖型生产率下的最优再分配
title_secondary: Optimal redistribution with labor supply dependent productivity
abstract: We study optimal nonlinear income taxation when productivity depends negatively on labor supply (labor-supply-dependent productivity, LSDP). Relative to a benchmark model with fixed productivities, we find that LSDP leads to higher optimal marginal tax rates, especially for higher-income individuals, and greater redistribution. The key mechanism is that, under LSDP, marginal taxation becomes a more effective screening instrument.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当生产率与劳动供给呈负相关（即劳动供给依赖型生产率，LSDP）时的最优非线性所得税问题。与生产率固定的基准模型相比，我们发现LSDP会导致更高的最优边际税率，尤其是对高收入群体而言，并带来更强的再分配效应。其关键机制在于，在LSDP条件下，边际税收成为一种更有效的筛选工具。

title: Locked in the past: Old housing and the adoption of electric heating
title_zh: 困于过去：老旧住房与电采暖的采用
title_primary: 困于过去：老旧住房与电采暖的采用
title_secondary: Locked in the past: Old housing and the adoption of electric heating
authors: Yi Jie Gwee, Hui Ren Tan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Can history explain some of the variation in electric heating usage across American homes today? Assembling a new county panel, we find that areas with more dwellings built before WWII are slower at adopting electric heating in later decades. This is due to old buildings being retrofitted more slowly and new buildings being less likely to have electric heating. We propose two ways to distinguish between persistence and path dependence as mechanisms, and show that our results largely reflect the latter. We document how various factors like natural disasters and government intervention can weaken the hold of history.

title: Business cycles, R&D, and hysteresis: searching for asymmetries
title_zh: 商业周期、研发与滞后效应：非对称性探究
title_primary: 商业周期、研发与滞后效应：非对称性探究
title_secondary: Business cycles, R&D, and hysteresis: searching for asymmetries
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: According to endogenous growth theory, temporary changes in R&D spending affect the flow of new technologies only temporarily, but their cumulative effect permanently alters the stock of knowledge and thus the level of aggregate productivity. Because R&D is pro-cyclical, business cycles and long-run growth may be connected. If shocks and responses are symmetric, the effects cancel out; if they are asymmetric, business cycle volatility and long-term growth become interdependent. We test for such asymmetries in U.S. aggregate R&D using standard empirical techniques. The main findings are that: (i) R&D spending expansions are 40% longer than contractions, but differences in their rapidity are not statistically significant; (ii) the pro-cyclicality of R&D is stronger when unemployment is particularly low; (iii) the pro-cyclicality of R&D is stronger when financing opportunities are more abundant. Therefore, the results underscore the importance of economic booms for understanding R&D’s pro-cyclicality, especially in periods of tight labor markets and easy credit. Moreover, we point to promising avenues for theory to explain these findings.

title: Optimal Covariate Discretization in Adaptive Randomized Experiments
title_zh: 自适应随机实验中的最优协变量离散化
title_primary: 自适应随机实验中的最优协变量离散化
title_secondary: Optimal Covariate Discretization in Adaptive Randomized Experiments
abstract: This paper introduces a novel method to adaptively design randomized experiments. For randomized experiments with a pilot stage, or multistage experiments, Hahn et al. (2011) propose an adaptive experimental design that adjusts the next stage's propensity score based on data from the previous stages. This paper discusses how the discretization of covariates affects the precision of the estimation of the average treatment effect (ATE) through the estimated propensity score for the next stage. Also, this paper proposes an algorithm using the bootstrap technique to find the optimal level of discretization of covariates. Monte Carlo simulations and an application with actual data show that the suggested method performs well.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种自适应设计随机实验的新方法。针对包含预实验阶段或多阶段随机实验，Hahn等人（2011）提出了一种自适应实验设计，该设计基于前一阶段的数据调整下一阶段的倾向得分。本文探讨了协变量离散化如何通过下一阶段估计的倾向得分影响平均处理效应（ATE）估计的精度。同时，本文提出了一种基于自助法（bootstrap）技术的算法，用于确定协变量的最优离散化水平。蒙特卡洛模拟及实际数据应用表明，所建议的方法表现良好。

title: The Curious Surge of Productivity in U.S. Restaurants
title_zh: 美国餐饮业生产率的神秘激增
title_primary: 美国餐饮业生产率的神秘激增
title_secondary: The Curious Surge of Productivity in U.S. Restaurants
authors: Austan Goolsbee, Chad Syverson, Rebecca Goldgof, Joe Tatarka
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: After remaining flat for decades, labor productivity at U.S. restaurants surged 15% during the COVID pandemic. The surge has persisted. We explore this using mobile phone data tracking visits and spending at 100,000 limited-service restaurants. It cannot be explained by scale economies, market power, or mechanical consequences of COVID demand fluctuations. However, restaurants’ productivity growth is strongly correlated with the share of their customers visiting for 10 minutes or less, which rose considerably during COVID and persisted. This restaurant-level relationship between labor productivity and customer dwell time is large enough to explain most of the aggregate productivity increase.
abstract_zh: 美国餐饮业的劳动生产率在数十年间保持平稳，却在新冠疫情期间骤增15%，且这一增长态势持续至今。我们利用追踪10万家有限服务餐厅客流量与消费额的手机数据展开研究。这种增长无法用规模经济、市场势力或疫情需求波动的机械效应来解释。然而，餐厅生产率增长与其顾客停留时间不超过10分钟的占比高度相关——该比例在疫情期间显著上升并持续保持。这种餐厅层面劳动生产率与顾客停留时间的关联强度，足以解释大部分总体生产率增长。

title: The quasi-prekernel for cooperative games
authors: Qianqian Kong, Hans Peters, Hao Sun

abstract: The quasi-prekernel is a novel solution concept for cooperative games. It is a refinement of existing prebargaining set solutions, notably the reactive, semireactive, and Aumann-Davis-Maschler prebargaining sets. It contains the prekernel, and coincides with that solution on simple games except possibly on balanced simple games with all individual worths equal to zero. An axiomatic characterization based on reduced game properties is provided. The steady version, obtained by putting conditions on objecting and counterobjecting coalitions, is considered as well. Finally, by considering objecting and counterobjecting coalitions independent of specific players, the socalled excess prebargaining obtains, which is another novel solution concept.
abstract_zh: 准预核是合作博弈中的一个新颖解概念。它是对现有预谈判集解的细化，特别是针对反应性、半反应性及奥曼-戴维斯-马斯勒预谈判集。它包含预核，并且在简单博弈中与该解一致，除非在个别价值均为零的平衡简单博弈中可能例外。本文提供了基于约简博弈性质的公理化刻画。同时，考虑了对反对联盟和反反对联盟施加条件的稳定版本。最后，通过使反对联盟和反反对联盟独立于特定玩家，得到了所谓的超额预谈判，这是另一个新颖的解概念。

title: College Financial Aid Application Frictions
abstract: We document that 11 percent of recent U.S. high school graduates did not apply for federal student aid due to difficulty in applying, mistaken beliefs, or lack of awareness. Not applying due to such application frictions negatively predicts college enrollment after controlling for other attributes. We represent application frictions as heterogeneous filing costs in a general equilibrium life cycle model of college enrollment. We find that eliminating these frictions generates modest gains on average because less than half of those affected would ultimately utilize aid. However, welfare gains are large for the affected few with high skill and poor parents.

title: Measuring the interwar housing boom: House prices and rents in England, 1913–39
title_zh: 两次世界大战期间住房繁荣的测度：1913–39年英格兰房价与租金
title_primary: 两次世界大战期间住房繁荣的测度：1913–39年英格兰房价与租金
title_secondary: Measuring the interwar housing boom: House prices and rents in England, 1913–39
abstract: Abstract Existing statistics about England's interwar housing market are sparse and based on outdated sources and methods. This article seeks to improve upon them by drawing on mortgage data from a major London‐based building society and using the hedonic method of price index measurement to construct house price and rent indices for residential houses that are robust to intertemporal sampling differences. It is found that house prices and rents in England both rose significantly between 1919 and 1926 but moderated thereafter and declined throughout the 1930s housing boom. Further evidence indicates that there was excess supply in the housing market during the boom, driven by cheap money and a deliberate strategy by building societies of ‘making the market’ by fuelling private house construction.
